import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem localized_compact_trace_basis {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
  (A : Set K) (hA : IsClosed A) (x : K) 
  (U : Set K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
  ∃ (V : Set K) (B : Set (Set {y : K // y ∈ A ∩ closure V})),
    IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U ∧
    IsClosed (A ∩ closure V) ∧ Set.Countable B ∧
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := by
  rcases (Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds hxU)) with ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩
  let V : Set K := Metric.ball x (ε / 2)
  
  have hhalf : 0 < ε / 2 := by
    linarith
  
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := Metric.isOpen_ball
  
  have hxV : x ∈ V := Metric.mem_ball_self hhalf
  
  have hclV : closure V ⊆ Metric.closedBall x (ε / 2) := by
    apply closure_minimal
    · exact Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    · exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall
  
  have hclVU : closure V ⊆ U := hclV.trans
    ((Metric.closedBall_subset_ball
      (x := x) (ε₁ := ε / 2) (ε₂ := ε) (by linarith)).trans hεU)
  
  have hcomp : IsCompact (closure V) :=
    isClosed_closure.isCompact
  
  have hclosed : IsClosed (A ∩ closure V) :=
    hA.inter isClosed_closure
  
  let S : Set K := A ∩ closure V
  
  let B : Set (Set {y : K // y ∈ S}) :=
    Classical.choose
      (TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis {y : K // y ∈ S})
  
  have hBcount : Set.Countable B :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis {y : K // y ∈ S})).1
  
  have hBbasis : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B :=
    (Classical.choose_spec
      (TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_basis {y : K // y ∈ S})).2.2
  
  refine ⟨V, ?_⟩
  
  change ∃ B : Set (Set {y : K // y ∈ S}),
    IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U ∧
    IsClosed S ∧ Set.Countable B ∧
      TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B
  
  exact ⟨B, hVopen, hxV, hcomp, hclVU,
    (by simpa [S] using hclosed), hBcount, hBbasis⟩

open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem localized_compact_trace_basis {K : Type*} [MetricSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
  (A : Set K) (hA : IsClosed A) (x : K) 
  (U : Set K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
  ∃ (V : Set K) (B : Set (Set {y : K // y ∈ A ∩ closure V})),
    IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ IsCompact (closure V) ∧ closure V ⊆ U ∧
    IsClosed (A ∩ closure V) ∧ Set.Countable B ∧
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis B := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hCcompact, hxC, hCU⟩ := exists_compact_subset hU hxU
  
  let V : Set K := interior C
  
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := isOpen_interior
  have hxV : x ∈ V := hxC
  
  have hclosureV : closure V ⊆ C :=
    closure_minimal interior_subset hCcompact.isClosed
  
  have hclosureCompact : IsCompact (closure V) :=
    hCcompact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hclosureV
  
  have hclosureU : closure V ⊆ U :=
    hclosureV.trans hCU
  
  have hclosedTrace : IsClosed (A ∩ closure V) :=
    hA.inter isClosed_closure
  
  have hcompactTrace : IsCompact (A ∩ closure V) :=
    hclosureCompact.of_isClosed_subset hclosedTrace inter_subset_right
  
  letI : CompactSpace {y : K // y ∈ A ∩ closure V} :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hcompactTrace
  
  have hcount :
      (countableBasis {y : K // y ∈ A ∩ closure V}).Countable :=
    countable_countableBasis _
  
  have hbasis :
      TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis
        (countableBasis {y : K // y ∈ A ∩ closure V}) :=
    isBasis_countableBasis _
  
  exact ⟨V, countableBasis _, hVopen, hxV, hclosureCompact, hclosureU,
    hclosedTrace, hcount, hbasis⟩
